steps.content:
August 1, N.F. 114
Banyan Medical College Hospital
Department of Mental Contamination
Six days have passed since the incident in Eastside. Various investigative reports are beginning to come back.

<color=#fb9259>[Eastside Public Security Bureau Investigation Report]</color>
Apart from the MBCC Chief, no one else witnessed the Mania apparition, including the Sinners with him.
After reviewing all footage taken by security cameras and citizens at the scene, as well as the testimonies of those present, we have concluded that Chief ${PlayerName} suddenly lost control without any external stimuli and suffered mental trauma. He has been sent to Banyan Medical College for emergency treatment.
steps.female_content:
<color=#fb9259>[Eastside Public Security Bureau Investigation Report]</color>
Apart from the MBCC Chief, no one else witnessed the Mania apparition, including the Sinners with her
After reviewing all footage taken by security cameras and citizens at the scene, as well as the testimonies of those present, we have concluded that Chief ${PlayerName} suddenly lost control without any external stimuli and suffered mental trauma. She has been sent to Banyan Medical College for emergency treatment.

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>[Dark Web Mania Detection Report]</color>
Leakages of digitalized Mania from the dark web continue to occur sporadically, but they are all incidents below Level <color=#fb9259>B</color>. On July 25, none of the M-value detection stations in major districts of Eastside issued alarms, and all values were within safe range.

<color=#fb9259>[Personal Medical Report]</color>
The health check for Chief has been completed. His mental state has stabilized. He passed all Mania safety tests, and his M-value is within safe range. Apart from slight stress from overwork, there are no pressing issues.
The subsequent analysis will be provided by the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center, who have studied the DisCity dark web and its related effects in depth, and has been working with the MBCC for much longer.
steps.female_content:
<color=#fb9259>[Personal Medical Report]</color>
The health check for Chief has been completed. Her mental state has stabilized. She passed all Mania safety tests, and her M-value is within safe range. Apart from slight stress from overwork, there are no pressing issues.
The subsequent analysis will be provided by the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center, who have studied the DisCity dark web and its related effects in depth, and has been working with the MBCC for much longer.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: That's all for now. The full reports from various departments amount to 546 pages and have been sent to your inbox.

<color=#fb9259>Rise</color>, an intern from the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center, took part in various support missions in the wake of the dark web threat. She is mainly responsible for liaising with the MBCC. Known for being diligent and responsible, she is well-regarded among partner departments.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: In summary: there was no large-scale Mania crisis. The apparition you saw was likely a hallucination caused by sensory cognitive disorder, Chief.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: It's <color=#fb9259>cognitive disorder</color>. People who are in long-term contact with the dark web may experience this kind of Mania reaction.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Digitalized Mania</color> is essentially a form of information pollution. In the unregulated depths of DisCity's dark web, there are copious amounts of dangerous info of unknown origin, including mental horrors like the Black Ring. Prolonged exposure can affect a person's cognition.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Mild cases may cause emotional fluctuations and dispirit, leading to paranoia. More severe cases can result in mental breakdowns and Mania infection. The <color=#fb9259>Gray Mirror</color> and <color=#fb9259>Elysiland</color> incidents are extreme examples.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Even technical specialists back at the Cybersecurity Center have to take shifts and breaks. It's not surprising at all for someone like you to sustain work injuries from continuous frontline exposure to contamination. Also...
Rise hands over a mask and sunglasses.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Please wear these when going out. Footage of you from the Eastside incident is now circulating the dark web. You need to be more vigilant when going out; being recognized could jeopardize your safety.

You try to recall what happened that day: the strange grid weaving across the sky, the mottled image noise, and the distorted projections of Corruptors. Even casting your shackles felt strange. It does indeed resemble a "cognitive disorder caused by the dark web exposure" like Rise described.

Yet for a "Mania reaction," your Mania tests showed no abnormalities. Plus, with the protection of your shackles, you've never been affected by such common Mania infections, and your M-value rarely fluctuates.

If it's powerful Mania like Black Rings that can overpower your shackles, it would certainly affect all the Sinners connected to you, but none of the Sinners showed any abnormalities on that day. The only one who collapsed was you, making it a veritable conundrum.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Please go home and get some rest. The colleagues at the Cybersecurity Center must have all been working around the clock because of my incident, and now you're here with me even on the weekend. I really appreciate all your efforts.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: No worries. We applied for overtime, so it's our working hours right now. We are just doing our job.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: If you really want to cause less trouble, then please take better care of yourself, both mentally and physically, to prevent work injuries. In my opinion, the energy you put into the dark web is way more than what your job requires. It's sapping your health needlessly.
She is not being too harsh, but it still makes you instinctively sit up.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: But the mastermind behind the dark web might be...

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Whatever it may be, it is not your current mission. We are not in a time of turmoil right now. You've completed all your tasks with flying colors, and need to unwind now.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: You've worked hard to bring six months of peace to this city. You should treat yourself well, too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is there anything else you wish to tell me?
You ask respectfully.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Folks from the Bureau will arrive in 15 minutes to fetch you. I will start my vacation this afternoon and won't be answering calls. Another colleague has already taken over. You may contact him if you need anything.

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: Goodbye then, Chief. Remember to send me proof of my overtime; I need it to apply for compensatory leave from Nirvana.
Rise adjusts her glasses, nods to you formally, then straightens up and strides out of the hospital.

True to the elite nature of Nirvana, even the interns are meticulous. In just two weeks, Rise's discipline has become well-known in the Bureau; her clear boundaries have earned her both trust and awe.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Clear boundaries...
You watch her walking away, think for a moment, then put on the mask and sunglasses she gave you and leave the hospital.
It is a bright summer day, boasting blue skies and sunshine. A warm breeze blows through the streets teeming with crowds and traffic.
As for the web of light you saw the other day... if no one else on the streets saw it, it might really be a sign of "cognitive disorder caused by the dark web and overwork."

The dark web Mania is rather a minor issue compared to the Black Ring operation and West District chaos ended six months ago, and DisCity is now finally basking in peace. For the first time since your awakening, a long period of peace.

But the more this continues, the more anxious you feel inside. Time passes, yet the calm doesn’t bring relief—instead, it leaves you even more on edge. When you close your eyes, it’s as if you can sense the dark currents of fate surging wildly in the shadows.
And what you fear most is that you cannot sense it.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: You think the Underground might be behind the dark web? Haha, good. That's the kind of intuition we need. Let's play along with them, shall we? A warmup before the big battle.

steps.speaker: Friend
steps.content: The new mine has successfully yielded Hypercubes. West District's economic lifeline is coming back. With that in mind, the internal disputes of the Reconstruction Committee don't constitute a major problem. Thanks for your concern.

steps.speaker: Subordinate
steps.content: Paradeisos has expressed gratitude for your support in the DisSea operation. Chief, you have won their trust. That's really great...

steps.speaker: Companion
steps.content: ...Please get some rest, Chief. You look really tired.
[Fade to black, 1 second]
This is a special gift from my lovely "little brother."
steps.female_content: This is a special gift from my lovely "little sister."

steps.content: [White out back to the street]

Snapping back to your senses, you still see sunny blue skies and teeming traffic before your eyes. The rising heat blurs your senses. The peaceful daily life is just in front of you, yet you are trying desperately to pull yourself away from those persistent nightmares.
Not being able to enjoy peace is probably an illness. You try to refocus your attention on the present, on the here and now.
The traffic light changes, and the cars ebb away. Your view is no longer obstructed.
You see a person standing on the other side of the road.
She looks back at you. Your eyes lock for a few seconds, and the girl walks towards you through the sunlight, stopping just an arm's length away.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: ...Were you... looking at me?

steps.speaker: Rise
steps.content: You need to be more vigilant when going out; being recognized could jeopardize your safety.
The girl stares at you, then smiles gently.

She reaches out to your nose, and before you can stop her, she hooks her finger around your mask and pulls it down. Taking advantage of your surprise, she stuffs her popsicle into your mouth with her other hand.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ??? Ptui, what are you doing?!
The girl responds to your reproach with a bright smile.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: A souvenir.

steps.speaker: Maiden
steps.content: To commemorate the fact that I found you <size=40>first</size>.
She talks in chunks, and combined with her sudden appearance, strange approach, and odd actions towards you...
You have a sudden epiphany.
She looks at you with a grin. Just as she is about to answer...

Time seems to stop for a moment. Out of nowhere, a flash of light bursts between you two, piercing the girl’s body. Her smile falters and distorts, as the web crisscrossing the sky rips through the space where you stand.

Several rifts surround you, sawing through your vision. Image noise overflows, condensing into strange shapes that lunge towards you... and the girl. You summon the shackles, trying to pull her towards you.
...But the girl's hand disintegrates in your grip the moment you reach out to her!
